verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a voice-agent platform, but the evidence shows Retell only as a hosted, account-based service with pay-as-you-go pricing. Bring-your-own SIP telephony and connecting to remote MCP servers are adjacent integrations, not self-hosting the core product. No documentation of on-prem or self-hosted deployment exists in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
